reports.career_corpus:
Aaron  (aaron)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7 swing directories across 4 sessions  ->  6 distinct swings, 5 distinct shots

  Honest n per metric:
    ball_speed_mph      n = 3
    carry_distance_yds  n = 3
    head_sway_norm      n = 4

  1 distinct swing(s) analyzed by an older engine (version 15; 16 is installed).
    Their numbers are not comparable with a swing analyzed today, so they are
    reported rather than pooled. Repair with: python scripts/reanalyze.py

  1 current-engine swing(s) carrying no measurement at all.
    Every metric returned None on them — a measurement failure, not an old
    artifact. Their checkpoint `observed` values are deliberately not read as
    measurements: it would mix two derivation paths under one metric name.

  1 distinct swing(s) naming no club (of 6).
    They still count toward every metric above and toward every whole-bag
    number — the club was never an input to measuring head sway — and are
    absent only from per-club views. Repair them one at a time on the upload
    page: a session has many clubs, so there is no bulk backfill (ADR-024 §5).

  Contributing no sample (2):
    outdated         1  2026-08-10/7i
    unattributed     1  2026-08-10/nobody
